news.title: Chairman & MD recently bought ₹69k worth of stock
news.body: On the 23rd of February, Dipak Patel bought around 750 shares on-market at roughly ₹91.45 per share. This transaction amounted to less than 1% of their direct individual holding at the time of the trade. In the last 3 months, there was an even bigger purchase from another insider worth ₹80k. Dipak has been a buyer over the last 12 months, purchasing a net total of ₹533k worth in shares.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹2.39 (vs ₹1.74 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹2.39 (up from ₹1.74 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹73.4m (up 53% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹7.17m (up 38% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 9.8% (down from 11% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 34% per year but the company’s share price has only increased by 5% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings growth.
